title: Unpaid Balance Counted for the In-Person Appointments Booking Deposit
content:
The unpaid balance counted for the booking deposit on an In-Person Appointments visit is selected this way:

1. where the patient's payment plan is active (Patient Payment Plans), it is the account's unpaid balance less the balance remaining on that plan;
2. where no payment plan is active and the patient's Patient Financial Account carries a financial-hardship approval above zero, it is the account's unpaid balance reduced by the approved hardship percentage and rounded to the cent;
3. otherwise it is the account's unpaid balance as it stands.

The account's unpaid balance is the patient balance shown on the Patient Financial Account; the balance remaining on the plan and its status are those shown on the patient's payment plan; the approved hardship percentage is the one recorded on the financial account.

**Input, judgement, output (hypothetical accounts).**

| Unpaid balance | Payment plan | Hardship approval | Branch | Balance counted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $640.00 | Active, $520.00 remaining | any | 1 | $120.00 |
| $640.00 | None active | 25% | 2 | $480.00 |
| $250.57 | None active | 30% | 2 | $175.40 (175.399 rounded to the cent) |
| $90.00 | None active | none | 3 | $90.00 |

Branch 1 is taken whenever a plan is active, whatever the hardship approval; branch 2 applies only when no plan is active.
